sample_unit: model configurations (6 datasets x 5 classifiers, plus external cohort of 2689 prostate cancer patients)

links.outcome: Association between per-prediction out-of-distribution/reliability category and prediction error
links.effect: Prediction error significantly associated with RADANCF category (ANOVA p < 10^-12), though non-monotonic; correct predictions appeared in all traffic-light categories in external validation.
links.quote: Prediction error was significantly associated with RADANCF category, although the relationship was not strictly monotonic, with intermediate categories showing the largest error contributions.

unlisted_practices: Per-prediction applicability-domain reliability categorization with traffic-light scheme for radiomics classifiers

screen.reason: The paper empirically develops and evaluates a post-hoc diagnostic guardrail framework (RADAN-CF) that flags unreliable individual predictions based on data representativeness and model behavior under distribution shift across multiple radiomics datasets.

primary.practice: applicability domain and prediction-level reliability filtering
